name: New Player Guide to Jin Dynasty
author: Shaada

notes: Rally reindeer until 4 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@, then rally @resource/resource_wood.webp@ making the first @building_economy/house.webp@ then. Only make @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ whole build.
@abilities/repair.webp@ @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ with 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ (they'll go back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ once done)
Once 3 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, rally back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until 7 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@
Train  @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ non-stop from both stables, adding in  @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ / @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ as desired (see video for variations)

Remacro @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ as needed for what units you're making (@unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ are very @resource/resource_gold.webp@ heavy). Send 5 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/boar.webp@. Be aggressive, raiding and containing your opponent while taking map control.

description:
As basic as possible Jin build order for new players making the most of the unique Jin cavalry. Video below!

The gameplan is Feudal aggression with Horsemen + Iron Pagoda + Mohe Tribesmen. The goal is to contain and raid your opponent, picking up villager kills when possible while taking deer/boar behind. It's a bit micro intensive for new players but very fun!

It's difficult to Feudal all-in as Jin so you'll often look to turn your advantage into a strong Castle Age timing, and perhaps even fast Imp (see below video!)

Good luck!
